notes: SuperFrenPet is an ERC-20 named Super Fren Pet (SFP) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 SFP once to msg.sender, the deploying factory. Transfers have no fees. There are no additional minting or administrative entry points and no application contracts. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
